description:
Title: Luxury Airplane

You produce airplanes.
While the base model is always the same, your customer likes to pimp their airplane with fancy interior.
You let them decide between a number of 5 different bars, the number of seats, their color, and the amount of water in the toilets of their plane (you can come up with additional stuff).
After you received the specifications you send the requirements to different teams to manufacture the parts.
E.g. manufacturing the vodka bar is done by the Russian team, the whiskey bar is manufactured by an Irish team.
After receiving the individual bits and pieces, the interior of the plane is assembled, and the plane is sent on a test flight.
During the flight you create a test protocol which is sent to you and the customer.
The plane is delivered to the customer, which has to confirm.

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LuxuryAirplane">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Specifications" name="Send specifications" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Confirmation" name="Send delivery confirmation" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Customer" name="Configure and receive luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Customer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ChooseSpecifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BarChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_BarChoiceMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendSpecifications</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Customer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ChooseSpecifications" name="Choose bar and specify seats, color, and toilet water amount" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoice" name="Which bar option was selected?" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge" name="Bar option selected" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendSpecifications" name="Send specifications to producer" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProtocol" name="Receive test protocol from producer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveAirplane" name="Receive airplane from producer" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendConfirmation" name="Confirm airplane delivery" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Customer" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_2" sourceRef="Task_ChooseSpecifications" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Vodka" name="Vodka bar selected" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "vodka"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Whiskey" name="Whiskey bar selected" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "whiskey"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Bar3" name="Bar option 3 selected" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "option 3"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Bar4" name="Bar option 4 selected" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "option 4"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_Bar5" name="Bar option 5 selected" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoice" targetRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "option 5"</bpmn:conditionExpression>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_3" sourceRef="Gateway_BarChoiceMerge" targetRef="Task_SendSpecifications" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_4" sourceRef="Task_SendSpecifications" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_5" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProtocol" targetRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_6" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveAirplane" targetRef="Task_SendConfirmation" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C_7" sourceRef="Task_SendConfirmation" targetRef="End_Customer" />
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Producer" name="Produce luxury airplane" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Producer">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Producer" name="Airplane producer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_SpecificationsReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendRequirements</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_ManufacturingMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveParts</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AssembleInterior</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TestFlight</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CreateProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendProtocol</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DeliverAirplane</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveConfirmation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_ManufacturingTeams" name="Manufacturing teams">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureVodkaBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureBarOption3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ManufactureBarOption4</bpmn:flowNodeRef>

      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_SpecificationsReceived" name="Specifications received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_SpecificationsReceived" messageRef="Message_Specifications" />
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendRequirements" name="Send requirements to manufacturing teams" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingChoice" name="Manufacture the selected bar" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" name="Selected bar manufactured" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" name="Manufacture vodka bar (Russian team)" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" name="Manufacture whiskey bar (Irish team)" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" name="Manufacture bar option 3" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption4" name="Manufacture bar option 4" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ManufactureBarOption5" name="Manufacture bar option 5" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive individual parts" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleInterior" name="Assemble airplane interior" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TestFlight" name="Conduct airplane test flight" />
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateProtocol" name="Create test protocol during flight" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendProtocol" name="Send test protocol to customer" messageRef="Message_TestProtocol" />
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DeliverAirplane" name="Deliver airplane to customer" messageRef="Message_Delivery" />
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveConfirmation" name="Receive customer delivery confirmation" messageRef="Message_Confirmation" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Confirmed" name="Delivery confirmed" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_1" sourceRef="Start_SpecificationsReceived" targetRef="Task_SendRequirements" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_2" sourceRef="Task_SendRequirements" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingChoice" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Vodka" name="Vodka bar selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "vodka"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Whiskey" name="Whiskey bar selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "whiskey"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Bar3" name="Bar option 3 selected" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingChoice" targetRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption3">

      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">selectedBar = "option 5"</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Vodka_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureVodkaBar" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Whiskey_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureWhiskeyBar" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Bar3_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption3" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Bar4_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption4" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_Bar5_Merge" sourceRef="Task_ManufactureBarOption5" targetRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_3" sourceRef="Gateway_ManufacturingMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_P_4" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_AssembleInterior" />
